name: twzrd-cosigner
description: TWZRD as a required payer-side co-signer. An opt-in approver worker: a wallet vendor's pending sign request (Turnkey first) comes in as an unsigned Solana transaction, TWZRD decodes the payment-shaped transfers, evaluates them against the rail-agnostic policy runtime + counterparty intel, and returns ALLOW/DENY with reason codes. A DENY means the payer's wallet never signs. Enforcing, permissionless (payer configures their own wallet quorum), no custody move, no on-chain deploy. Reuses twzrd-x402-gate's PaymentIntent + policy-runtime + DecisionToken as the decision brain. This is NOT _cosign_fee_payer (that is TWZRD-as-facilitator-fee-payer on an already-signed sponsored settle); this is TWZRD-as-payer-policy-co-signer before the payer signs.
